component.name: ZestBay
component.summary: PipeWire patchbay with LV2, VST3 and CLAP plugin hosting

description.p: ZestBay is a visual audio routing tool for PipeWire. It shows every audio node in your system — applications, hardware devices and virtual sinks — and lets you connect and disconnect ports with drag-and-drop.

ul.li: Host LV2, VST3 and CLAP effect and instrument plugins inline as real PipeWire filter nodes, with their native editors
Patchbay rules that restore your routing whenever devices or applications appear, learned automatically from the connections you make
Exclusive or non-exclusive rule enforcement, and a default target for applications without a rule
Map hardware MIDI controllers to plugin parameters with one-click learn
Plugins, parameters, links, MIDI mappings and node layout persist across restarts
System tray with start-minimized, so routing rules keep working in the background

description.p: Plugins packaged as Flatpak extensions (org.freedesktop.LinuxAudio.Plugins) are supported. Plugins installed by your distribution are also scanned, but ones that depend on host libraries may not load inside the sandbox.

screenshot.caption: The patchbay: devices, apps and hosted plugins wired by signal type
Auto-connect rules, learned from the connections you make
Add LV2, VST3 and CLAP plugins
Per-plugin DSP load and process CPU

description.p: A complete redesign and the first stable release.

ul.li: New interface with dark and light themes that follow the desktop, a toolbar, a status bar and a new logo
Redesigned graph: quiet node cards, signal-coloured wires, collapsible unused ports, live search, pin and default markers
Snap to grid with a configurable grid size; Auto layout follows the grid
Redesigned dialogs, including format filters in Add plugin, parameter filtering and Reset all, and a log-scale CPU chart
Exclusive Mode: with it off, patchbay rules only add links and never disconnect anything
Richer tray menu with plugin UIs, rules toggles and quick actions
Effect plugins keep chains such as microphone, effect, headset running on their own
Many fixes: saved positions, theme detection under qt6ct, Qt 6.4 support, scrolling, CPU chart smoothness
